title: Trade Server - Deals, Diamond Rain, Wishlist
features:
About this script
AbirVoid Hub — Military Tycoon: Trade Server Hub v1.0.0 Released!

Dominate the Trade Plaza, snipe underpriced vehicles, and stack diamonds with the ultimate Military Tycoon Trading tool!

KEY FEATURES

Live Deals Scanner & Snipe Feed

• Scans all trade servers (via Terminal) or current server stands in real time.

• Category filters: Air (Planes), Water (Boats), Ground (Tanks), Soldiers & Drones, or Exotics.

• Custom criteria: set Min/Max price & minimum % Below RAP.

• Continuous Auto-Scan loop with configurable cooldowns & hop-state saving.

• 1-Click Teleport / Hop: Instantly lands at the seller's stand.

:dart: Multi-Target Wishlist Monitor

• Search & multi-select specific vehicles/items to watch with live RAP brackets.

• Background polling loop monitors servers for your target items.

• Instant sound alert & optional auto-hop when a wishlist item is found on any stand!

Diamond Rain Auto-Collector

• Automatically sweeps & collects diamond gems dropped during rain events.

• 3 collection modes: Humanoid Walk/Run, Smooth Tween, or Instant Touch Magnet.

• Auto-Hop to Rain: Automatically joins servers hosting an active Diamond Rain drop!

• 1-Click button to claim all active workspace gems instantly.

Live RAP & Market Price Checker

• Check exact live RAP, rarity, and market trends for any vehicle or soldier.

• Lowest Price Finder: Queries all active trade servers to find the cheapest listing, seller name, player count, and lets you hop straight to it!

:convenience_store: My Stand & 8% Fee Calculator

• Scans your owned stand and active item listings.

• Compares your listing prices against live RAP.

• Calculates the exact suggested price to cover the 8% trade server fee so you net full RAP on sales!

• 1-Click teleport directly to your stand.
